page.overview:
Who is Descendant of Apep?

Descendant of Apep is the official name given to the character controlled by the player in the Mortal Kombat 11 Krypt.

He makes a cameo appearance in the Mortal Kombat 11: Aftermath story mode, where he is found by Shang Tsung, Fujin and Nightwolf, having been killed by one of the Shaolin Dungeon's traps. They happen upon his corpse when Shang Tsung touches a pressure plate with his staff to get around the spear trap containing the Descendant's corpse.
